remarks: Live the Shippan Point lifestyle in the waterfront community of Palmer Landing. This bright end-unit offers sparkling water views and a well-designed layout with custom built-ins, detailed millwork, and gleaming hardwood floors. The updated kitchen features granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, while the spacious dining area flows into a living room with a fireplace. Step outside to a large deck overlooking the marina - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The primary suite boasts a walk-in closet, a spa-inspired bath, and a private balcony with sweeping harbor views. Two additional bedrooms and updated baths provide ample space, while an upper-level laundry room and cedar closet add convenience. Community amenities include a garage, pool, and clubhouse, with the cc's covering heat and water. Minutes from Stamford's beaches, parks, downtown, and Metro-North. Ask about available boat slips!
